actions.reason: Interpretable VHL/PBRM1-enriched, BAP1-depleted mutation phenotype (ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:2e98e40a49), but membership representation is weak and partially conflicting: CT silhouette -0.034 with 63% of patients closer to a competing set, RNA near-null 0.012, WXS modest 0.223, and the nearest competing set differs across modalities (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:2e98e40a49). Pair boundaries to both K4_C0002_M_K4_C0003_S1 and S2 are only weak-to-modest with substantial negative fractions (ER:...pair:0e75c65797, ER:...pair:a4ed7e36a3), and membership is significantly associated with tissue source site, CT phase, and CT manufacturer (Cramer's V 0.23-0.31), a plausible technical explanation not excluded (ER:...confounder_association:set:2e98e40a49). No supported split or merge alternative remains, so the candidate lacks defensible independent discovery value.

Coherent oxidative-phosphorylation/fatty-acid/mTORC1 transcriptomic phenotype (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:34d7d3469d), but membership representation is largely non-supportive: RNA -0.058, WSI -0.044, WXS -0.059 with high negative fractions (52-77%), only CT weakly positive (0.054), and the nearest competing set differs across modalities (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:34d7d3469d). Boundaries to K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004 and to sibling S2 are only weak-to-modest with non-trivial negative fractions (ER:...pair:0e75c65797, ER:...pair:6630b46305), and membership is significantly associated with a broad set of technical factors including tissue source site, CT manufacturer, reconstruction kernel, scanner model, CT phase, slice thickness, and z spacing (Cramer's V up to 0.46), a plausible technical explanation not excluded (ER:...confounder_association:set:34d7d3469d). No supported split or merge alternative remains.

Coherent immune/inflammatory transcriptomic phenotype (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:156205f616), but membership representation is weak and inconsistent: RNA 0.150 and CT 0.056 positive while WSI -0.040 and WXS -0.029 with non-trivial negative fractions (60% and 45%), and the nearest competing set differs across modalities (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:156205f616). Boundaries to K4_C0001_M_K4_C0004 and to sibling S1 are only weak-to-modest with non-trivial negative fractions (ER:...pair:a4ed7e36a3, ER:...pair:6630b46305), and membership is significantly associated with tissue source site and with slice thickness and z spacing (Cramer's V=0.44; epsilon-squared 0.08-0.11), a plausible technical explanation not excluded (ER:...confounder_association:set:156205f616).
